Aniimo Beginner Guide - MUST KNOW TIPS For NEW PLAYERS
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking a little bit more about Animo, which is a free to play open world RPG that just launched. And in this video, I want to be giving you guys some beginner tips on how to get going in this game. If you have just started playing or you're considering it and you're just going to get into it, like today or tomorrow, there are a lot of things to cover in this game.

Redeem Code "aniimotogether" for an in-game gift.
